title: Hotel Rate Plans — Sale Limits and Booking Charges Schedule
content:
A reservation may be sold on a rate plan of the Hotel Rate Plans range only within the limits set against that plan in this schedule. The figures below are the contracted terms of each plan and apply to every property the plan is offered at.

| Rate plan | Advance purchase, days | Minimum nights | Maximum nights | Booking window, days | Rooms per reservation | Group desk from, rooms | Agency service fee, USD | Currency conversion markup |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | 7 | 1 | 14 | 330 | 3 | 4 | 19.95 | 3.5 percent |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | 21 | 2 | 21 | 365 | 3 | 4 | 17.95 | 3.5 percent |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | 3 | 1 | 28 | 365 | 5 | 6 | 14.95 | 3 percent |
| Standard Flexible Rate | 0 | 1 | 30 | 365 | 8 | 9 | 12.95 | 3 percent |
| Member Flex Rate | 0 | 1 | 30 | 365 | 8 | 9 | 0.00 | 2.5 percent |
| Suite Flexible Rate | 3 | 2 | 21 | 365 | 4 | 5 | 9.95 | 2.5 percent |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | 14 | 3 | 21 | 400 | 4 | 5 | 0.00 | 2 percent |

**What each column is.** The advance purchase distance is the minimum number of calendar days between booking and arrival for the plan to be sold. The minimum and maximum nights are the shortest and longest stay the plan may be booked for. The booking window is the furthest ahead of arrival, in calendar days, that the plan may be booked. Rooms per reservation is the largest number of rooms one reservation may hold before group terms apply, and the group desk figure is the number of rooms from which the group desk takes the booking instead. The agency service fee is the agency's booking service fee charged once per reservation. The currency conversion markup is the percentage added where the guest elects to be charged in a currency other than the property's own.

**Reading the schedule.** A three-night stay booked ten days ahead sits inside the Semi-Flexible Rate limits, whose advance purchase distance is 3 days and whose minimum is 1 night; the same request is outside the Advance Purchase 21 Rate, whose advance purchase distance is 21 days. A party wanting five rooms is at the room ceiling of the Semi-Flexible Rate but one room above the group desk figure of the Suite Flexible Rate.
